title: Tsukimichi: Moonlit Fantasy
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: High schooler Makoto Misumi is summoned to another world, but its goddess rejects him for his looks and dumps him at the edge of the world without even the common language. With vast magic and two powerful servants, the dragon Tomoe and the spider Mio, he builds a merchant business and makes his way among humans, demi-humans and demons. The manga adapts Kei Azumi's light novel.
life_message: It holds up making your own way and treating the outcasts of the world fairly, whatever the powerful think of you.
